question: What native context-pressure behavior should OpenClaw support for saturated child sessions: observe-only diagnostics, parent/operator notification, or automatic recovery/rerouting?
rationale: Current code exposes context usage and has subagent lineage, liveness, and restart-recovery paths, but the requested threshold, parent notification, operator target, and recovery action are not existing contracts and would create new product/API behavior.

options.title: Add observable diagnostics first
options.body: Define a context-pressure diagnostic for child sessions and expose it in status or health so operators can act without automatic rerouting.

options.title: Notify parent and operator
options.body: Add an explicit threshold policy that sends a parent-session or operator notification while leaving recovery manual or parent-directed.

options.title: Automatic recovery or rerouting
options.body: Build recovery actions that compact, restart, or reroute saturated children, accepting a broader orchestration contract.

recommendation.title: Add observable diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Define a context-pressure diagnostic for child sessions and expose it in status or health so operators can act without automatic rerouting.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent subagent/session history make steipete the best available routing candidate for choosing the owner boundary before implementation.
